style_preamble: Match the approved Math Dragons style bible: stylized semi-realistic fantasy digital painting for ages 7-14, Wings of Fire book-cover influence with Clash Royale readability, warm dramatic lighting, rich scale texture, clear readable silhouette, expressive amber eyes, polished mobile game asset. Avoid chibi proportions, plastic toy rendering, flat vector outlines, baby-cute nursery style, grimdark horror, classroom motifs, text, watermarks, and UI elements.
geometry_rule: Preserve the exact pose family: same canvas size, crop, bounding box, body orientation, head angle, horn placement, skull plane, eye line, wing position, and accessory attachment landmarks. Small silhouette drift is acceptable; perspective drift is not.

contexts.description: Full-body standing dragon companion, front three-quarter view, facing slightly left. Full dragon visible, paws grounded, tail visible, wings folded enough to keep the body readable. Designed for hub companion, customize screen, shop preview, and accessory calibration.

Tighter portrait/bust dragon view, front three-quarter view, facing slightly left. Head, horns, neck, upper chest, and some wings visible. Designed for profile, celebration, and portrait-style game appearances.

stages.name: egg
stages.description: A single large magical dragon egg with the species color expressed only in shell markings, shell material, cracks, and inner glow. The egg is the only subject. No dragon, no hatchling, no baby dragon, no creature, no face, no eyes, no limbs, no wings, no tail, no claws, no accessories, no nest characters. Centered and readable.

stages.name: hatchling
stages.description: A tiny hatchling dragon, alert and curious, small horns beginning to grow, stubby folded wings, readable skull top and neck attachment areas.

stages.name: fledgling
stages.description: A small fledgling dragon, more defined scales and horns, compact wings, confident but still young, readable head, neck, chest, and wing landmarks.

stages.name: young
stages.description: A young dragon in full recognizable dragon form, lean and heroic, folded wings, curved horns, clear skull, neck, chest, and wing attachment landmarks.

stages.name: adult
stages.description: A majestic adult dragon, powerful but readable silhouette, folded wings, elegant horns, clear accessory landmarks on skull, neck, chest, and wings.

stages.name: elder
stages.description: An ancient elder dragon, wise and powerful, crown-like natural horns allowed but skull accessory area must remain readable, subtle arcane markings, clear accessory landmarks.

themed_accessories.theme_rule: Create a crown that harmonizes with the dragon skin/species color while remaining clearly royal and readable. Keep warm fantasy metal as the base but adapt gems, enamel, glow, and accent metal to the target dragon skin. Crimson uses ruby and ember accents; Sapphire uses blue sapphire and silver-blue accents; Emerald uses emerald and vine-gold accents; Amethyst uses amethyst and violet-gold accents; Golden uses polished gold, white-gold, and sunstone accents; Obsidian uses darkened gold, ruby, and smoky red accents with strong rim highlights; Frost uses white-gold, pale blue crystal, and icy silver accents; Sunset uses orange-gold, coral, and ember accents.
